name: @myne/ornaments
//: Shared ornament layer (myne#394) — the stylesheet that draws every ornament primitive plus the role helper that routes a component to it. Consumed as SOURCE by the desktop/web client (src/) and the mobile client (myne-mobile/src/), so all three clients render a theme's ornament identically BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by three implementations agreeing. The theme only ever NAMES a variant; what that variant draws lives here, which is what keeps pseudo-elements, composite shadows and textures reachable without widening the theme value allowlist.
